sentences.en: She made references to World War II in her speech.
sentences.zh: 她在演讲中提到了二战。

sentences.en: I can give two of my former teachers as references.
sentences.zh: 我可以提供两位以前的老师作为参考。

sentences.en: We can use the church as a point of reference.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用这座教堂作为参照点。

senses.zh: 参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书
